_about: Custom product pages: one per job, each with its own screenshots and the search keywords it answers. Keywords must already be in the app's approved keyword field (store/listing-data.mjs). Framed by the iOS store screenshots workflow into store/pages/<id>/; published by scripts/asc-pages.mjs.
